section:
### A further comparison between arms

Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. This comparison was run at the Oakfield Family Cohort.

Table 5. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 8.3 | 4.2 | 700 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 13.8 | 6.9 | 700 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 8.1 | 4.0 | 700 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Cardivel | Systolic drop | 11.5 | 5.8 | 700 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
